_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 2020 Dec breakout analog and current ETF flow strength support a push into Belief, but diverging macro hedges (gold, VIX) mean confirmation requires stablecoin growth recovery and funding acceleration.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both call UP, but the analyst conditions it on factor convergence while the narrative writer treats it more straightforwardly.
next_move.confirmed_if: stablecoin_growth breaks above 60 and funding rises above 65 with BTC holding above 75K
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 25 or gold strength pushes to 100+ while BTC funding turns negative and exchange netflow rises above 50
